$comment: Presentation registry of the MaxBLD lot report v2: everything a field with source `content:<key>` reads (labels, plain-words maps, formats, states, illustrations, Street View block, ad placements). Not lot data. Checked both ways by scripts/analysis/report-schema.mjs RS-4 (every key referenced by report-v2.decl.json, every reference resolves). Rulings cited by Q-id from scripts/surfaces/_schema/report-v2.rulings.json.

display_label.note: card titles by scenario code; {dwelling_units} filled from the card (H is 4 or 6, gap 1)

trust_label.precedent_estimate: Precedent estimate (Committee of Adjustment), not law

status_text.not_buildable: Allowed, but nothing fits on this lot as of right.
status_text.not_modelled: This option is not modelled yet, so no figure is shown.
status_text.not_applicable: Does not apply to this lot.
status_text.not_evaluated:exception_not_authored: A site-specific exception applies; not yet evaluated.
status_text.not_evaluated:no_existing_house: There is no existing house on this lot to renovate.
status_text.not_evaluated:needs_user_input:existing_: Enter the number of storeys of your house to see this result.
status_text.not_evaluated:needs_user_input:semi_lot: This lot looks like half of a semi-detached house. Enter your house details to see renovation options.
status_text.not_evaluated:coa_factor_unfitted: Not enough past Committee of Adjustment builds of this form to estimate.
status_text.not_evaluated:coa_factor_unfitted:suite: Not enough past Committee of Adjustment rear-suite builds to estimate (Q-4: calibrating).

field_trust.note: per-field trust is not generated yet: the catalogue rows carry no trust tier (McBylaws catalogue, row owed); never hand-listed

disclosure_texts.note: code → {template, slots, importance, mandatory} parsed from Spec 78 P5.12 by the generator; filled server-side from disclosure_params

area_unit.note: today the screen mixes formatSqm (lot) and formatSqft (GFA), [parcelId].tsx:128-130

lifecycle.miss: No report for this lot yet.
lifecycle.error: Could not load this report. Try again.

lot.limits_gated: Site exception: exception noted, not yet modelled

checked.ready: The Building Possibilities Report for {address} is ready.

states.semi_needs_input: This lot looks like half of a semi-detached house. Tell us about your house to see what you can add.
states.semi_correction: This isn't a semi — it's detached
states.note: Spec 78 §6.6 rules 1, 5, 8: hidden states are counted, never shown as cards; null renders "—", never 0 or "no"

lot_form_rules.note: O-12: the pipeline never reads the override; the app applies it through the P5.7 shared pure function

ad_placements.targeting_excludes: user identity (targeting runs server-side on the lot / scenario context only)
ad_placements.note: Q-7 (decided; operator: "This will be targeted ads from us"): first-party targeted ads, a separate top-level offers[] list, never inside parcel.* (Spec 100 §2.1). Q-8 (decided): two slots — after the scenario cards (detail_footer) and in the renovation section; never inside a card; always labelled Sponsored. Placement home is the placements table (Spec 128 R-34 (i)); this list is what projects into it. Disclosure: Spec 128 R-17 (FAIL) + R-34 (ii) blocking. MF-20 (operator 2026-11-09, "all approved as recommended"): the response channel is the declared ui.ad_slots.* fields bound to the ad contract (scripts/surfaces/_schema/ad-contract.json); offers[] stays the deferred serving list. A third slot, scenario_card, sits BESIDE each scenario card. Targeting keys are database keys only (zone_class, building_type, design_option); the retired keys scenario, building_class, has_suite and renovation have no database source yet and return when their rows land; income is never a key (pending a human-rights review).

street_view.owed: re-check Google Maps Platform current pricing and terms before a spec cites them (the only analysis is archived Spec 74:164-176)
street_view.caption: Street View photo — illustrative only
rules: fetched server-side: panorama metadata lookup nearest the centroid, heading = bearing pano → lot, signed URL
never store image bytes (cache pano_id only)
always show attribution and imagery date; never crop the in-image logo
never used as a data input (storeys are owner input only, O-13)

page.page.title: The Building Possibilities Report
page.spec.label: By-law specifications
page.tile.size.label: Max Build Size
page.tile.cost.label: Cost to Build
page.var.label: By-law variances
page.ls.title: Know your exact lot size?
page.ls.body: Survey data is more accurate than our estimate. Add lot size and every option is recalculated.
page.tile.unit.label: Size per Unit
page.legal.line: This is an estimate, not 100% accurate. Not legal advice. Confirm with a lot survey and the City.
page.footer.change: By-laws and maps change and may not show recent amendments. For a formal answer, apply to Toronto Building for a Zoning Applicable Law Certificate.
page.sheet.p: Use the lot area from your survey. It replaces the City lot record for this report, and every option is recalculated.
page.sheet.label: Lot size from your survey
page.sheet.note: You can enter the lot size once. It is saved with this lot and marked as entered by you.

illustrations.per_card: all assets with the card key, in view order (a small carousel)
illustrations.note: Q-10 (decided; operator: "Each scenario shown will have a few different photos with it"): several static illustrations per card. No new-build or suite variant on a semi_half lot (Q-1/Q-3 decided): those cards are never shown there; renovation diagrams keep a semi variant. file: null = not drawn yet
